essence: By the grace of goddess Ṣaṣṭhī one becomes very long-lived.
The goddess bears multiple affiliations as Viṣṇu-related, Śiva-related, sister of nāgas, and mistress of nāgas.
The goddess possesses great knowledge and receives universal worship.
Protection from nāga-fear applies both to the devotee and to his descendants.
The practice is relevant in extreme danger from nāgas and when encircled by them.
